description: This file defines a PHP trait 'DateRangeSearchFilterParamsTrait' which provides properties and getter/setter methods for handling date range filters (fromDate and toDate) within the OrangeHRM's Leave module.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the 'from' date of the range, or null if not set.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the 'from' date of the range.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the 'to' date of the range, or null if not set.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the 'to' date of the range.
